stories.statLabel: year its editor won the Nobel
stories.headline: Russia's Novaya Gazeta newspaper will close
body: Novaya Gazeta, one of Russia's best-known independent outlets, will shut permanently next month.
It says it was stripped of its newsroom, donation platforms and legal right to publish.
Its former editor Dmitry Muratov won the 2021 Nobel peace prize.
stories.vc: Shrinking free press makes Russia's economy harder for outsiders to read, adding to investment risk.

stories.statLabel: pope known to vote in a political election
stories.headline: Pope Leo votes in the US midterms by post
body: Pope Leo, born in Chicago, has voted in the US midterm elections by post.
He is the first sitting pope known to vote in any political election.
The Vatican says he has always voted when eligible, including in Peru.
stories.joke: His ballot was secret. His opinions on several issues, less so.
stories.vc: Even symbolic moves by global figures can sway turnout narratives in a close election.

stories.headline: Cost-of-living protests spread to Germany on Halloween
body: Youth-led protests over living costs and poor public services are expected to spread to Germany and flare again in France.
A German group called 'Gen Z regelt' has called rallies in more than 30 cities.
Weeks of protests have hit Italy, Spain, Portugal, Albania and France.
stories.joke: Halloween costume of the year: angry renter.
stories.vc: Political pressure over prices could push European governments to spend more, affecting bond markets.

stories.headline: Spain's PM says trust in high-speed rail is 'broken'
body: Pedro Sánchez admitted trust in high-speed rail has been broken after Wednesday's crash killed at least 69 people.
More than 100 were injured; victims include people from at least 23 countries.
He promised to find the cause of Spain's second deadly collision this year.
stories.vc: Expect big spending on rail signalling and safety, a market for European rail-tech suppliers.

stories.headline: Sensex rises 308 points, Nifty tops 23,000
body: The Sensex gained 308 points on Friday and the Nifty rose 116 points to 23,053.
Vedanta Oil and Gas jumped 8%.
It was the second strong day in a row for Indian shares.
stories.joke: Two good days in a row. Don't jinx it.
stories.vc: A steady market helps the long queue of tech IPOs waiting to list.

stories.headline: Jio Platforms' first results as a listed company: profit up 14%
body: Jio Platforms made ₹8,387 crore in the September quarter, up 13.7% from a year earlier.
Revenue rose 11.4% to ₹40,475 crore.
Other income jumped about 50%, helping profit.
stories.joke: Week one on the stock market, and already reporting profits. Overachiever.
stories.vc: Steady telecom profits underpin Jio's huge valuation; investors will watch whether tariffs rise next.

stories.headline: Delhivery swings to a profit as revenue tops ₹3,000 crore
body: Delhivery made a ₹40.6 crore profit in the September quarter, against a ₹50.5 crore loss a year ago.
Revenue grew 19.8%, faster than costs.
Its board approved up to ₹36 crore for its fintech distribution arm.
stories.joke: The parcel arrived. So did the profit.
stories.vc: Logistics firms are finally showing profits, which helps the sector's valuations and IPO pipeline.

stories.headline: SEBI clears fan maker Atomberg's IPO
body: Markets regulator SEBI has cleared Atomberg's IPO, with a fresh issue of up to ₹450 crore.
Existing shareholders will also sell 7.65 crore shares.
Atomberg plans to use ₹90 crore to repay debt.
stories.joke: Atomberg's fans are about to get a lot more fans.
stories.vc: Consumer hardware IPOs test whether Indian investors pay up for D2C brands beyond software.

stories.headline: Navi gets regulator nod for $100M from Prosus
body: The Competition Commission cleared Prosus's $100 million investment in Sachin Bansal's fintech Navi.
It is Navi's first institutional funding round.
Navi reportedly plans a ₹3,000 crore IPO.
stories.joke: Flipkart's co-founder now has institutional friends.
stories.vc: A top-tier investor before IPO gives Navi credibility with public market buyers.

stories.headline: Policybazaar parent PB Fintech's profit rises 42%
body: PB Fintech made ₹192.4 crore in the September quarter, up from ₹135 crore.
Revenue rose 35% to ₹2,177.7 crore.
Profit rose 18% from the previous quarter.
stories.joke: Insurance comparison: now with a profitable comparison.
stories.vc: Insurtech turning profitable suggests India's online insurance market is maturing.

stories.headline: DoorDash has had only 'several hundred' orders from AI agents
body: DoorDash says third-party AI agents have placed only several hundred orders in total.
That compares with about 3 million deliveries a day.
CEO Tony Xu says not to fight the trend, but not to be delusional either.
stories.joke: The robots aren't ordering your dinner yet. They're still reading the menu.
stories.vc: 'Agentic commerce' is hyped; real usage numbers like these help investors separate demo from demand.

stories.headline: Google's first data-centre satellite is online
body: Google's Suncatcher prototype satellite is working and talking to the ground after launching this month.
It carries four Google TPU chips and makes up to 1 kW of power.
Power limits mean it can run one chip for about 20 minutes at a time.
stories.joke: Cloud computing, taken a little too literally.
stories.vc: Space data centres are a long shot, but they promise solar power without land or grid fights.

stories.headline: AI law firm Crosby bids for parts of collapsing Weil Gotshal
body: Two-year-old AI-first law firm Crosby has bid for Weil Gotshal's brand, trademark and some data.
It is also trying to hire some of Weil's 1,200 lawyers.
The famed Wall Street firm is preparing to vote on dissolving.
stories.joke: Plot twist worthy of 'Suits': the startup buys the old firm's name.
stories.vc: AI-native service firms buying legacy brands could be a new way to disrupt professional services.

stories.statLabel: date a ban vote was blocked
stories.headline: Indigenous woman reportedly shackled while giving birth in Australia
body: An imprisoned Indigenous woman was reportedly shackled in a Queensland hospital during a caesarean birth this month.
Human Rights Watch says this breaks international standards.
Days earlier, Australia's two main parties blocked a parliament vote on a bill to ban the practice.
stories.vc: Maternal health in custody is part of a wider care gap that costs health systems more later.

stories.statLabel: generations of Democratic votes in Starr County
stories.headline: Latinas' regret over Trump could swing the midterms
body: Latinas were less likely than Latino men to back Trump, but their shift right helped him win in 2024.
In Texas's Starr County, some say promises on prices never came true.
Their disappointment could now help Democrats.
stories.joke: Campaign promises: the original subscription you can't cancel fast enough.
stories.vc: Latina voters are a fast-growing consumer and voting bloc that brands and campaigns increasingly target.
